title: Exact universality of symmetric quantum circuits for arbitrary permutation actions

comparators.scope: 17 fixed explicit contracts covering all eight numbered results, actual circuit construction/resource equations and the conditional Choi appendix.

comparators.rejection_detail: Additional premise changes the fixed theorem type
injectedFalse is outside the permitted axioms

main_results.scope: A unitary on a finite register has a clean symmetric circuit exactly when it is equivariant, including the empty-register case and the stated nonuniform gate/workspace bounds.
An equivariant unitary for any group action on a finite register admits a clean symmetric circuit through the action's finite permutation image.
A specified symmetric block encoding with success probability strictly between zero and one admits exact clean oblivious amplification with the stated resource bound.
Given the specified clean symmetric Choi-state preparation and register lifts, constructs the Bell/swap block encoding, clean amplifier and resource bounds.
